name: Diagonal Thumbnails
description: Full-screen slider with a tilted cluster of four thumbnails behind large split-character headlines. Slides change with arrow buttons or keys, with images flying diagonally and characters sliding in.
contents: Slides, each with three title lines and four images
Custom circle cursor that follows the mouse
behavior: Left and right arrow keys or buttons change slides with a looping order
Outgoing images slide away diagonally while incoming images slide in with a stagger
Title characters slide and rotate in and out per character
Custom cursor follows the pointer with easing and grows over arrows, shown only on fine pointers
editableByProps: Slide titles and the four images of each slide, number of slides
Background, text and cursor accent colors
Cluster rotation, gap, width, image opacity, travel distance
Title and middle line sizes, fonts, weights and tracking
Animation durations and stagger, cursor size and easing, cursor on or off

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the diagonal directions images travel in
Change arrow button position or artwork
needsCodeEdit.where: Previous slide and Next slide button elements

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the image sizes and stagger layout of the four thumbnails

fixed: Listens to ArrowLeft and ArrowRight on window and removes the listeners on unmount
Adds a Google Fonts stylesheet link to the document head from fontUrl
Root is full viewport height with a 700px minimum and clips overflow
Cursor circle is fixed to the viewport and only appears on fine pointer devices
Each slide uses exactly four images
